patterns.what_worked: The other four classes' landed shape was the template: read the guide's own verdict, never re-decide it. The engine's accessor (practice.lua:3450) settled the CANCEL question without guesswork - the brief's own tiebreaker ('a step that names an action stays an action') plus the class's own invariant that the practice pick and the live pick can never disagree.
patterns.what_was_hard: The scope list named two sunder-default pin files; the harness proved a third (tests/hud_templates_state.lua), so the scope needed a one-line widening. And the CANCEL verdict is the one hold that names an action, so 'the three holds are stated' is two as holds and one as an action - documented with the guide's own pin rather than papered over.
patterns.skill_gap: A pin cannot be trusted to be the only pin of its kind: three suites pinned the same default. A rule that says 'update the pin' needs to say 'update every pin of that default', or the lane finds the red by running the harness.
